title: JOYOR C10E(ABE) City Commuter Scooter (Removable battery)
sellingPoints: Complies with German road traffic regulations
The body is light and foldable, easy to carry when traveling
Removable battery, can be replaced at any time, no worries about battery life

details.title: 500W Powerful Motor
details.content: The C10 E e-scooter is equipped with a 500W high-power brushless motor, which enables rapid acceleration and 20-degree climbing ability. Regardless of the terrain, its maximum speed can reach 20 km/h.

details.title: removable battery
details.content: The C10 E electric scooter is equipped with a 48V 10.4Ah removable rechargeable battery, which can achieve an ultra-long range of 30 to 40 kilometers under ideal conditions. At the same time, its maximum load capacity reaches 120 kg, ensuring a stable and reliable riding experience.

details.title: Hydraulic spring shock absorber
details.content: C10 E features hydraulic front suspension and 10" pneumatic tires for smooth rides on rough roads.

details.title: Foldable and portable
details.content: The C10 E electric scooter has an unfolded size of 1190*590*1300mm and a folded size of 1160*620*550mm. It weighs 19.5kg and is easy to transport and store. It is an ideal choice for commuting to school, work or short trips.
The scooter features a smart LCD showing speed, mode, battery, and lighting.
High-brightness headlights ensure safe driving in low-light conditions.

moreDetails.caption: High-efficiency disc brake system provides stable braking performance even at high speeds
Provides dual charging options to provide users with a more flexible and convenient charging experience
